description: National Land Survey of Finland (NLS) is planning to purchase a large format airborne camera system for aerial photography, which optimally supports the current main use cases of NLS: large area 30 cm GSD imaging with 80 / 30% overlaps for ortho photo production and stereo mapping. NLS Finland is the leading party in the execution of the National Laser Scanning and Aerial Imaging program called KALLIO, in where Finland is being photographed with a three year’s rolling cycle. As a general remark regarding the data policy in Finland we’d like to bring to your attention that image data with 30 cm GSD or more (≥ 30 cm) is open data. The same packet processing hardware can be used for different business objectives asthe requirements and the techniques evolve.
